name: 30097 · Duluth, GA
findings: ZIP 30097 (Duluth) has 280 nonprofit organizations. 94 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30097 (Duluth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30097 (Duluth) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 71 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
